{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...... All right. Then I'll wait.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Trusting your word...{n}{fd:028000800180}{n}{fe:028002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I don't want to hear words meant only to smooth things over.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Trust won't be the only thing you lose.{n}{fe:028002800180}{n}{fd:028001800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}As long as you understand... But I'd like you to see something like this before I have to say it.{n}{fd:028000800180}{n}{fe:028001800180}{n}{fe:028002800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}What? You're busy? ...Oh. Then my bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I just called because I wanted to see you. Coming to see your hero is your duty, right?{n}{fd:038000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:C880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Nah... I figured you were busy too, but I wanted you to hear me out.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Shouldn't I have called you? Well, if you say it's not like me, that's that. My bad.{n}{fd:038000800380}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
